title: ACTIVATING PRAYER MORNING BLESSINGS TO PROSPER AS YOU START YOUR DAY
text: Something is happening in the realm of the spirit before the sun fully climbs over the horizon this morning and I need you to stop whatever your hands are holding and pay attention to what is being loosed over your life right now. There is a shifting taking place. There is a door creaking open somewhere in eternity and it has your name written across the threshold. Before you scroll to this place, before you press play, heaven had already scheduled an appointment with your morning. You did not stumble into this by accident. Something in you got up today hungry for more than routine, hungry for more than another day that looks like yesterday and I decree to you that this is not going to be an ordinary morning. This is an altar. This is a launching pad. Something in your spirit knew that today required a different posture and that is why you are here. I want you to lift your hands where you are, whether you are in your room, in your car, in your kitchen, wherever this meets you and I want you to say to the Lord, "Speak to me this morning because I am tired of waking up and drifting through the day like a leaf carried by the wind. I am tired of being reactive. I want to be positioned. I want to be aligned. I want the blessing of the Almighty to catch up with me before the enemy's noise does. Something about the dawn carries a governmental authority in the spirit realm and this morning we are going to legislate. Lamentations chapter 3 verse 22 and 23 tells us that his mercies are new every morning. Great is his faithfulness. That is not simply poetry for a plaque on your wall. That is a legal statement about the nature of God's dealings with the sons and daughters he has covenant with. Every single morning mercy is renewed. That means whatever verdict was written over your life yesterday, whatever the enemy tried to seal into your file while you slept, this morning carries the authority to overturn it. Psalm 5 verse 3 says, "My voice shall thou hear in the morning, O Lord, in the morning will I direct my prayer unto thee, and will look up." David was not a lazy worshiper. David understood that the morning was a courtroom, and if you did not show up early to plead your case, someone else's decree would stand over your day by default. I prophesy to somebody right now, the reason your days have been chaotic, the reason things have been slipping through your fingers, is because you have been letting the day start without you. You have been letting circumstances set the agenda instead of you setting it in the place of prayer. Not today. Today we rise. Today we take the microphone of the spirit before the devil takes his. Today we speak first. There is something prophetic about the structure of creation itself. Genesis chapter 1:5 says, "And the evening and the morning were the first day." Notice the order, evening first, then morning. Darkness does not have the final say in God's calendar. Morning always closes the chapter. Whatever evening season you have been walking through, the evening of delay, the evening of sickness, the evening of a marriage under pressure, the evening of a business that keeps folding, I announce to you by the spirit of the living God that evening is not your permanent address. Morning is coming to close that chapter. And if morning already came naturally today, then I speak a supernatural morning over the parts of your life still trapped in night. Somebody say, "It is morning over my finances." Somebody say, "It is morning over my family." Somebody say, "It is morning over my body." Somebody say, "It is morning over my destiny." Mark chapter 1:35 records that Jesus, rising up a great while before day, departed into a solitary place, and there prayed. If the Son of God who had unbroken fellowship with the Father, who was never for 1 second out of alignment with heaven's will, still found it necessary to seize the morning in prayer, what audacity do we have to assume we can afford to skip it? He was not praying because he was weak. He was praying because he understood that the morning sets the tone for dominion. Before he cast out a single demon that day, before he healed a single leper, he had already met with the Father in the dark hours before dawn. I want you to understand something. Your morning prayer is not a religious formality. It is a strategic occupation of territory before the enemy arrives to plant his flag. There is a boldness rising in my spirit right now and I need to release it. I decree over you every scheme that was assigned to ambush you today has just been exposed by the light of this word. >> [music] >> Every trap set for your finances, your health, your relationships, I call it null and void in the name that is above every name. You will not fall into what was dug for you. You will not walk into what was arranged against you. This morning your steps have been redirected by a higher hand. Let's go back to Psalm 30:5 >> [music] >> because it says weeping may endure for a night, but joy cometh in the morning. I have met people who have been weeping for so long they forgot joy was even scheduled to visit. Somebody has been crying into their pillow about a womb that has not opened, about a file that keeps getting rejected, about a relationship that keeps disappointing them, about a body that keeps betraying them with pain. I speak to that weeping right now. Your appointment with joy is not canceled. It has only been delayed by resistance in the spirit and this morning that resistance is broken. Joy is not asking for permission anymore. Joy is coming whether the circumstances have changed yet or not, because joy in the kingdom is not always a reaction to change circumstances. Sometimes joy is the weapon that changes them. I feel something rising, a violent hunger in this place, in this moment, to shake off mediocrity. I refuse to let anyone leave this world the same way they arrived. Isaiah 50:4 says, "He awakeneth morning by morning. He awakeneth mine ear to hear as the learned." There is an ear opening that God wants to do in the morning hours, a divine tutorial that cannot be accessed at any other time of day with the same clarity. That is why the enemy fights your sleep, fights your mornings, fights your quiet time, because he knows that is where instruction is downloaded that will position you for the rest of the day. If you have been missing your mornings, I'm not condemning you, but I am waking something up in you right now. Something has to change. The blessing you are asking God for in the night season is often released in the instructions he wants to give you in the morning season, and you have been sleeping through your download. Now, hear me. This is not about legalism. This is not about earning God's favor by waking up at 4:00 a.m. like it is a badge of spiritual pride. This is about positioning. A farmer does not wake up early because waking up early makes him righteous. He wakes up early because the harvest requires it. Prosperity in the way the kingdom defines it requires positioning. Proverbs 8:17 says, "I love them that love me, and those that seek me early shall find me." There is a finding attached to early seeking that is not guaranteed to the one who seeks late. It is not that God plays favorites. It is that the early seeker has fewer voices competing for their attention. Fewer distractions have had the chance to plant themselves, and the heart is more tender before the noise of the day hardens it. I prophesy over your morning right now from today, your first thoughts will belong to God before they belong to your problems. Your first words will be declarations before they become complaints. Your first movement will be toward the altar before it is toward your phone. I decree that the enemy has lost his access to your first hour in the name of Jesus. There is warfare in the timing of things. Look at Joshua chapter 6, the children of Israel rose early to march around Jericho. Look at Exodus chapter 14 verse 27, where it says the sea returned to his strength when the morning appeared, drowning the pursuing army of Pharaoh. Morning was the appointed hour of judgment against the enemies' forces. And in 2 Kings chapter 19 verse 35, when the angel of the Lord went out and smote 185,000 in the camp of the Assyrians, the record says, "And when they arose early in the morning, behold, they were all dead corpses." The victory had already happened while Israel slept, and it was only confirmed when morning broke. I decree over your life this morning, while you were resting, angels were working. While you were unaware, the Lord of hosts was already dismantling the camp assigned against you. This morning is not the beginning of your battle. This morning is the confirmation of a victory that was already settled in the courts of heaven. Rise up and look, your enemies are already dead corpses. They just have not received the news yet. Somebody shout, "It is finished before it started." Let me take you to Exodus chapter 16, the story of the manna. The bread fell every single morning fresh, and it could not be stockpiled for tomorrow's provision. Every day required a fresh gathering. This is a picture of grace and prosperity. You cannot live off yesterday's blessing. You cannot survive today on last year's testimony. God is saying I have fresh bread for you this morning, but you must come and gather it. You must posture yourself to receive it. Some of you are trying to survive on a manner that fell 5 years ago and it has gone stale. It is breeding worms of complacency and God is saying come again, gather again because I have new mercy, new strategy, new provision for this exact day. Malachi chapter 4 verse 2 speaks of the sun of righteousness arising with healing in his wings. I speak to every sick body listening to this word right now. The sun of righteousness is rising over you. Whatever the doctors have called incurable, whatever diagnosis has tried to write your obituary before your time, I decree that healing is in his wings and those wings are spreading over you this morning. You will not die before your season of fruitfulness. You will live to declare the works of the Lord. I sense the atmosphere shifting. I need you to open your mouth and begin to declare with me. Say it out loud wherever you are. This morning I take authority over my day. This morning I refuse every evil pattern assigned to repeat itself in my life. This morning I decree that what did not work for me in the past will not define my future. This morning I call forth open doors that no man can shut. This morning I release the blessing of Abraham over my finances. >> [music] >> This morning I command every closed womb, every closed account, every closed door connected to my destiny to hear the voice of the Lord and open. I feel something breaking in the spirit as those words leave your mouth. There is a difference between a wish and a decree. A wish hopes something happens. A decree spoken from a covenant position carries legal weight in the spirit realm because Job 8 verse 7 says, "Though thy beginning was small, yet thy latter end should greatly increase." Your beginning does not determine your ending. Your family's history does not determine your trajectory. Somebody's start is about to become somebody's testimony of great increase. And I call your name out of insignificance this morning. Now, let us move into the place of contending because prosperity in the kingdom is not passive. It is contended for in prayer. And this morning we are not just receiving a teaching, we are engaging in warfare. Deuteronomy 28 from verse two to verse eight lists blessings that overtake, not blessings you chase, but blessings that chase you down and catch you. Blessed in the city, blessed in the field, blessed is the fruit of your body, blessed is your basket and your store, blessed when you come in, blessed when you go out. I decree those blessings are being released over you this morning. And I want you to begin to pray with violence, not against people, but against every spiritual obstruction standing between you and what God has already ordained for you. Father, in the name of Jesus, we come before you this morning as sons and daughters who refuse to be casual about our destiny. We thank you that your mercy met us fresh today, that we did not wake up to judgment, but to another opportunity to walk in covenant. Lord, we ask you to forgive us for every morning we squandered, every dawn we slept through spiritually, even while our bodies were awake. Restore unto us what the years of spiritual laziness have eaten. Restore unto us what distraction has stolen. I decree destiny restoration over somebody right now. Every gift that has been buried under fear, every calling that has been suppressed by rejection, every assignment that has been delayed by wrong associations, I call it forth this morning in the name of Jesus. You will not die with the treasure still inside you. To everything there is a season, and I declare that your season of manifestation has begun. What people wrote off as a failed attempt, God is about to reintroduce as a divine set up. Get ready, because what looked like the end of your story was only a comma, not a full stop. Lord, we lift up the families represented by everyone hearing this word. We ask for deliverance over households that have been fractured by generational patterns, anger passed down like an inheritance nobody wanted, addiction repeating itself from one generation to the next. Silence and bitterness sitting at dinner tables that should be filled with laughter. Lord, we cancel every family altar that was built without your permission. We break every soul tie to ungodly patterns in the bloodline. We speak restoration to relationships between parents and children, between siblings who have not spoken in years because pride built a wall neither one wants to be first to tear down. I decree that this morning reconciliation is being scheduled in homes represented by the people receiving this word. Malachi chapter 4 verse 6 says he shall turn the heart of the fathers to the children and the heart of the children to their fathers. That turning is happening right now in the spirit over your family. Every prodigal connected to your bloodline, I call them home. Every estranged relationship, I call it toward restoration, not because the offense did not happen, but because the blood of Jesus is louder than the offense. Somebody's marriage is under this word right now, and I want to minister life into it. Marriage was never designed by God to be a battlefield. Though the enemy has worked hard to convince couples that conflict is inevitable and unbreakable. I speak to every marriage represented by someone listening. I break the spirit of strife, the spirit of comparison, the spirit of unmet expectations weaponized into daily arguments. I call forth understanding where there has been confusion. I call forth patience where there has been short temper. I call forth romance where there has been mere cohabitation. Genesis 2:24 says a man shall leave his father and his mother and shall cleave unto his wife and they shall be one flesh. I decree a fresh cleaving this morning. Old wounds that have kept two people sleeping in the same bed but living in separate worlds are being healed. For the single ones believing for a spouse, I decree that confusion around who is for you and who is a distraction is lifting. Divine encounters are being arranged not by desperation but by design. Let us press further into financial breakthrough because prosperity is named directly in the assignment of what we are doing this morning. >> [music] >> And I refuse to spiritualize away something God cares about deeply. 3 John 1:2 says, "Beloved, I wish above all things that thou mayest prosper and be in health even as thy soul prospereth." Notice the order. Soul prosperity precedes and undergirds material prosperity. This morning, I decree that the prosperity of your soul, your peace, your faith, your identity in Christ is being established as the foundation for the prosperity of your hands. Malachi 3:10 speaks of the windows of heaven being opened and I speak to every window that has been shut over your income, your business, your job search, your investments open in the name of Jesus. I decree the release of ideas that generate wealth. I decree connections that were assigned to you before the foundation of the world finally locating you. I decree that every financial drainage pipe operating secretly in your life, the ones you cannot explain, where money comes in but never seems to stay, is sealed shut this morning by the blood of Jesus. Somebody's health is on the line this morning, too, and I will not preach around it. Isaiah 53:5 says, "And with his stripes we are healed." >> [music] >> Not we will be healed someday. We are healed a legal, finished covenant reality that we walk into by faith. I lay hands in the spirit on everybody represented in this world right now. Every tumor, every infection, every unexplained pain, every diagnosis that has frightened the family, I speak the resurrection life of Jesus Christ into that body. Psalm 103:3 says, "Who forgiveth all thine iniquities, who healeth all thy diseases." All means all. I decree strength returning to weak knees, clarity returning to confused minds, function returning to organs that have been struggling. If it is in your body right now, hiding, waiting to announce itself later, I call it out by the light of this word and command it to die at the root. Now we must deal with what has been operating in the dark. Some of what you have been experiencing is not natural. It is the fruit of covenants your ancestors made without your consent, evil altars erected in ignorance or in rebellion. Curses spoken over bloodlines in moments of anger that have quietly been working generation after generation. Galatians chapter 3:13 tells us that Christ had redeemed us from the curse of the law, being made a curse for us. I stand in that redemption this morning and I speak directly to every altar raised against your family's peace, your family's prosperity, your family's health be dismantled by fire in the name of Jesus. Every covenant signed in blood, in ritual, in secret oath by any ancestor living or dead that is still exerting authority over your life, I revoke it. You do not have to inherit what you did not choose. The blood of Jesus is a better covenant sealed with better promises and I declare that covenant supersedes every other one operating against you. I call for angelic intervention over every situation you are facing that requires supernatural transportation, supernatural timing, supernatural favor. Psalm 34:7 says the angel of the Lord encampeth round about them that fear him and delivereth them. I decree an encampment of angels around your home, your car, your workplace, your children as they step outside today. Hebrews chapter 1:14 calls angels ministering spirits sent forth to minister for them who shall be heirs of salvation. You are an heir. This morning I dispatch angelic assistance to go ahead of you into every meeting, every negotiation, every hospital appointment, every difficult conversation you must have today. Where you cannot see the way, angels have already been assigned to make crooked places straight before you arrive. There is a witchcraft dimension to some of what has been resisting your progress and I will not shy away from naming it plainly because the Bible does not shy away from it either. Numbers chapter 23:23 says surely there is no enchantment against Jacob, neither is there any divination against Israel. I decree that every incantation spoken over your name in secret gatherings, every image fashioned to represent you for evil purposes, every dream sent to manipulate your subconscious and steal your peace at night, I command it to backfire and return to its sender in the name of Jesus. You are not Jacob by struggle alone, you are Israel, a prince with God, and no enchantment holds legal power over a covenant child. I break every satanic assignment scheduled to hinder your breakthrough today. I scatter every gathering convened in the spirit realm to discuss your downfall. Let there be confusion in the camp of the enemy the way there was confusion in the camp of the Midianites when Gideon's 300 stood with trumpets and broken pitchers. Somebody needs restoration of time. Yes, that sickness ate. Yes, that the wrong relationship swallowed. Yes, spent chasing something that was never meant to be your portion. Joel 2:25 says, "And I will restore to you the years that the locust have eaten." I decree that God is not just going to bless your future, he is going to reach back and restore the value of what was lost in your past. What would have happened by now if the delay had not happened? God is going to compress into a shorter season. Amos chapter 9:13 speaks of the plowman overtaking the reaper. That is a picture of accelerated harvest where the planting and the reaping collapse into the same season instead of being years apart. I decree that acceleration over your assignment. What should have taken you 10 years to build, grace is going to help you build in a fraction of that time because this is not a season of gradual crawling, this is a season of supernatural acceleration. I also decree the restoration of virtue for everyone who feels drained, everyone who has been giving and pouring and serving until there is nothing left in the tank. Everyone whose joy has been leaking out slowly without them noticing. Mark chapter 5 tells the story of the woman with the issue of blood and Jesus perceived that virtue had gone out of him. Even Jesus needed to acknowledge when strength had left his body through ministry to others. I speak to your depleted strength this morning, be restored. I speak to your joy that has been quietly disappearing, be replenished. You cannot keep pouring from an empty vessel and God is filling you back up this morning so that what you give to others going forward comes from overflow, not from your last reserves. Now, here this divine preservation is what covers everything else we have prayed. What good is breakthrough without protection to enjoy it? Psalm 91, that great Psalm of covering, says he that dwelleth in the secret place of the most high shall abide under the shadow of the Almighty. I decree that shadow over you today, over your travel, over your health, over your children, over your decisions. Verse 10 says there shall no evil befall thee, neither shall any plague come nigh thy dwelling. I speak that exact protection over your household this morning. Every accident that was scheduled for your road today, cancelled. Every ambush that was set for your business meeting today, exposed and cancelled. Every silent attack aimed at your peace of mind today, intercepted before it lands. I want you to say this boldly, I am preserved, I am covered, I am not available for premature death, premature failure, or premature loss. My latter days are greater than my former days, and nothing assigned to cut my story short will succeed in the name of Jesus. Let me minister something further into the atmosphere before we close because I believe there are specific words for specific people in this gathering. There is someone whose business has been on the verge of a decision, a partnership, an expansion, a resignation, and you have been afraid to move because the last time you took a risk, it did not go well. I release courage into your spirit this morning. God is not asking you to repeat the past. He's asking you to trust the process this time because this time he is the one who orchestrated the setup, not your own ambition. There is a mother somewhere praying for a child who has drifted from the faith, drifted from the family, drifted into choices that keep her up at night. I decree that child is coming back. Isaiah 49:25 says, "I will contend with him that contended with thee, and I will save thy children." God is fighting that battle on your behalf even while you sleep. There is someone who received a report this week that shook them, a medical report, a financial report, a relational report, and you have been carrying it silently, smiling on the outside while your insides are in turmoil. I decree that the report you are believing for is louder than the report you received. Romans 4:17 says, "God calls those things which be not as though they were." I call your healing as though it has already manifested. I call your provision as though it has already arrived. I call your restored relationship as though the reconciliation has already happened. There is someone who has been comparing their timeline to everyone else's, watching friends get married, get promoted, get pregnant, get their breakthrough, while you feel stuck. I release you from the prison of comparison this morning. Your race was never designed to look like theirs. Hebrews chapter 12:1 talks about running with patience. The race that is set before us, not the race set before your neighbor, your sister, your classmate, the race set before you specifically. Stop measuring your obedience by someone else's finish line. >> [music] >> There is someone whose sleep has not been peaceful lately. Dreams of falling, dreams of being chased, dreams that leave you waking up more tired than when you lay down. I decree over your sleep tonight and every night going forward, no weapon formed against your rest shall prosper. Psalm 4:8 says, "I will both lay me down in peace and sleep, for thou Lord only makest me dwell in safety." Every altar assigned to speak to you in the dream realm without your consent, I silence it now. There is someone carrying the weight of a decision nobody else knows about, whether to stay or go, whether to speak or remain silent, whether to forgive or keep the wall up. James chapter 1:5 says, "If any of you lack wisdom, let him ask of God that giveth to all men liberally." I decree wisdom flooding your mind this morning concerning that exact decision. You will not make this choice from panic, you will make it from peace because clarity is coming before the deadline arrives. Something is opening up in the spirit right now, and I need to move quickly because there are specific words trying to locate specific people before we close, and I do not want anyone to miss what belongs to them. Somebody, there is a letter coming. It has been sitting somewhere, delayed, and it is about to reach you. Somebody, the phone call you have been dreading is not the phone call you think it is. It carries better news than you expect. Somebody, stop apologizing for outgrowing people who refuse to grow with you. That is not pride, that is obedience. Somebody, the numbers in your account are about to stop making sense to you in a good way. God is about to do something your budget cannot explain. Somebody, there is a piece of land, a property, a building connected to your future that has your name written on it in the spirit realm, and doors are opening toward it. Somebody, the friendship you thought was over is going to be restored but differently healthier, more honest than it was before. Somebody, the exam result you are waiting for is going to surprise you. Stop rehearsing the worst outcome. Somebody, there is a child in your bloodline, yet unborn, who will carry a double portion of everything you are contending for right now. Your labor in prayer is not only for you. Somebody, the job interview is not the final word. The offer is coming from a place you did not even apply to. Somebody, that chronic tiredness, that fog you have been living under is lifting. It was oppression disguised as ordinary fatigue. I decree over the sound of your voice every time you open your mouth from this day forward to speak destiny, agreement is forming in the spirit realm on your behalf. Amos 3:3 asks, "Can two walk together except they be agreed?" Heaven is agreeing with you right now. Every word you release in faith today has backup. I prophesy that somebody's testimony is going to make other people uncomfortable because it will not look like it followed the normal timeline. It will look sudden. It will look unfair to those watching from the outside because they did not see the years you wept in secret. Let them be surprised. Let them ask questions. Your sudden is a result of your seed, not a shortcut. There is somebody who has been quietly grieving a version of their life that did not happen. The marriage that ended, the child that did not come the way you planned. The career that took a different shape than you dreamed at 22. I speak comfort into that grief this morning. Grief and faith are allowed to sit in the same room. You do not have to pretend it disappointment did not happen in order to still believe God for what is next. Isaiah 61:3 speaks of beauty for ashes, the oil of joy for morning. I decree that exchange over you. Bring him your ashes and watch what he hands you back. There is somebody whose greatest breakthrough this year will not come through more effort, but through obedience to one specific instruction. They have been avoiding a conversation to have, a habit to release, a relationship to let go of, a step of faith to finally take. I release courage to obey that instruction today, not tomorrow, not next month. 1 Samuel 15:22 reminds us that to obey is better than sacrifice. You do not need another prayer point. You need to do the one thing you already know to do. I feel a final surge of authority rising and I want to release it as one closing wave of decree over everyone connected to this word. From this morning forward, you will not operate in confusion about your identity. You will not wander through your days uncertain of your worth. You will know whose you are and knowing whose you are will settle every question about who you are. Every plan of darkness assigned against your prosperity, your health, your family, and your peace is officially disbanded in the name of Jesus. Every blessing that has been in transit, delayed by resistance you could not see, is released to arrive on schedule starting today. I speak over your children, they will not be casualties of the battles you fought before they were born. I speak over your finances, they will testify of God's faithfulness to those who thought your family was cursed by lack. I speak over your body to carry you into the fullness of your assignment, strong and whole. I speak over your relationships, they will be marked by honesty, tenderness, and covenant loyalty, rather than manipulation and fear. Let us pray one final time together before we release this morning into motion. Father, we thank you for meeting us here. We thank you that not one word spoken over this gathering will fall to the ground void, for your word does not return to you empty, it accomplishes what you send it to do. We ask that everything decreed here in faith would begin to manifest in the natural, in Jesus' mighty name. We commit this day into your hands. We commit our families, our finances, our bodies, our relationships, our dreams into your hands. Watch over us as we go out. Go before us where we cannot see, and stand behind us where we cannot defend ourselves. We receive your mercy fresh for this exact day, and we will not waste it. This morning is not just a moment you consumed, it is a seed planted into the rest of your year. Go from here expecting. Go from here alert. Go from here refusing to let the enemy narrate your day for you. The messages that met you at dawn are still working on your behalf right now, and they will still be working when the sun goes down tonight, because his faithfulness does not clock out at noon. Let this be the last thing you carry with you as you step into everything this day requires of you. You are not walking into today alone, you are not walking into today unarmed, and you are not walking into today unnoticed by heaven. Somebody in the courts of glory has already been assigned to walk this exact day out with you. Walk boldly. Walk expectantly. Walk like a son. Walk like a daughter. Walk like someone who has already read the last page and knows how the story ends. Before you close this word, I want to leave one final charge with you because a word without application is only entertainment. And I did not carry this fire this morning to entertain you. I carried it to activate you. Everything that has been decreed here will not build itself into your life automatically. Faith without corresponding action, James tells us, is dead being alone. So, do not just say amen and go back to the same habits that kept you far from your mornings. Build a habit out of this hour. Let today be the day you decide that your mornings belong to God first. Your problems second. Let today be the day you decide that your mouth will decree before it complains. Let today be the day you decide that whatever this word stirred in you will not be allowed to cool by lunchtime. Write down what you heard. Write down the scripture that pierced you the deepest. Return to it tomorrow morning and the morning after that until declaration becomes your default language instead of your emergency language. Prosperity, the kind that outlives a single good season, is built by people who show up consistently at the altar before they show up anywhere else. You have been armed this morning. Do not walk out of this atmosphere and leave the weapon behind. It is well with you. It is well with your house. And this morning by every word that has gone forth, it is decreed you will prosper as you go.
